title: Partial sleep deprivation

draft.title: Partial sleep deprivation
card: Partial sleep deprivation is getting less sleep than the body needs. It can happen night after night, or after one short night.
It affects mood. A person may become irritable, more easily upset or less able to manage emotions.
It affects thinking and reactions. Attention, memory and decision making get worse, and responses become slower.
Staying awake for about 17 hours affects performance about as much as a blood alcohol level of 0.05. Staying awake longer has a greater effect.
draft.remember: Too little sleep dulls mood, thinking and reaction time, much like alcohol does.

a.q: Which result is most likely after several nights of partial sleep deprivation?
opts: Slower reactions and poorer attention
Faster reactions and sharper memory
Better mood but slower thinking
No change, as the body adjusts at once
a.why: Partial sleep deprivation slows reactions and weakens attention. Better mood is the tempting option, but sleep loss usually makes mood worse, not better.
a.clue: Think about what sleep loss does to performance.

b.q: Jess has been awake for 17 hours and must drive home from a late shift. Which comparison best describes her condition?
opts: Similar to a blood alcohol level of 0.05
Similar to a blood alcohol level of 0.00
Similar to a blood alcohol level of 0.15
Better than normal, as she is alert from work
b.why: After about 17 hours awake, performance is affected about as much as at a blood alcohol level of 0.05. A level of 0.00 would mean no effect, which is wrong because her reactions and thinking are already impaired.
b.clue: Recall the number linked to 17 hours awake.

b.best: Similar to a blood alcohol level of 0.05

problems.detail: "Dulls mood" is confusing and partly at odds with the card. The card describes heightened emotional reactions (irritable, more easily upset, less able to manage emotions), which is closer to amplified emotion than dulled mood. A wording like "worsens mood" would match the card.

check.summary: Facts and both questions check out: 17 hours awake is about a BAC of 0.05, and each question has one clear answer. The remember line's "dulls mood" does not match the card's description of heightened irritability and should be reworded.
